description: Java class implementing media session management for Android, handling media controls, audio focus, and metadata updates within the Cobalt project.

classes.name: CobaltMediaSession
classes.description: Manages Android media session, handles media controls, audio focus, and metadata updates for media playback.

classes.name: MediaMetadata
classes.description: Holds current media metadata such as title, artist, album, artwork, and duration.

methods.name: setMediaSession
methods.description: Initializes and configures the MediaSessionCompat object with callback actions.

methods.name: updateMediaSession
methods.description: Updates playback state, actions, and metadata in the media session.

methods.name: updatePlaybackState
methods.description: Builds and sets the current playback state in the media session.

methods.name: updateMetadata
methods.description: Updates media metadata including artwork in the media session.

methods.name: onArtworkLoaded
methods.description: Callback when artwork image is loaded; updates metadata artwork.
